name: What maintenance is required for installed trim?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for installed trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Properly installed and finished trim requires minimal maintenance. Regular dusting and occasional cleaning with a mild, non-abrasive cleaner are generally sufficient. For painted trim, touch-ups may be needed over time due to wear or minor impacts. We advise homeowners to choose durable, high-quality finishes during the design phase of their project to ensure longevity and preserve the craftsmanship of their residential design-build investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installed trim requires minimal maintenance like dusting and cleaning. Occasional paint touch-ups may be needed. Choosing durable finishes during the design phase ensures longevity.
